title: The Hymn of Old Chapel Road
author: Lena Iversen
blurb: Bram Voss, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
